# Crypto ecosystem partner programs

<!-- Generated by scripts/partner-programs.mjs from data/partner-programs-crypto.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Ecosystem grants, accelerators, hackathons, wallet and app directories, infrastructure startup programs, and co-marketing routes across crypto, Solana first. Solana is the home chain and leads every wave; EVM chains are secondary surfaces. $THREE is the only coin three.ws promotes: joining an ecosystem program is working with that ecosystem, never promoting its token.

It is the wide net. The narrower docs stay authoritative for what they cover: [partners.md](../partners.md) is what each live partnership **is** and how to describe it, [opportunities.md](./opportunities.md) is the stuck-item pipeline, [prospects.md](./prospects.md) scores the 3D and avatar ecosystem, and the [listings registry](../listings-registry.md) tracks directories and awesome-lists.

Sibling pages: [big-tech partner programs](./big-tech-programs.md), [ai company partner programs](./ai-programs.md), [motion partner programs](./motion-programs.md), [global brand partner programs](./brand-programs.md), plus [who promotes partners](./promotion-programs.md) and [moonshots](./moonshots.md) across every sector.

**115 programs across 107 companies.** 3 member / live, 3 submitted, waiting, 44 eligible, not started, 46 verify fit first, 19 retired or closed. We hold at least one membership at 3 of the 107 companies, and 31 of the open programs offer some form of promotion. Last full research sweep: 2026-11-06.

## Using this page

```sh
npm run programs:next -- --sector crypto   # the ranked next actions, top 15
npm run programs:due -- --sector crypto    # deadlines and expiring benefits in the next 30 days, submissions to chase
npm run programs:promo -- blog --sector crypto   # programs that will promote us, by type
npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "Submitted the application" --status submitted --ref <url>
npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "Cloud credits" --value "USD 25,000" --state received --received 2026-11-06 --expires 2027-11-06
npm run programs:build                    # regenerate this page after editing data/partner-programs-crypto.json by hand
```

`--log` and `--benefit` update [data/partner-programs-crypto.json](../../data/partner-programs-crypto.json) and rebuild this page in one step. Log every submission the day it happens, with the confirmation link or email subject as `--ref`; log every benefit the day it lands, with its expiry. That is the whole tracking discipline.

**Scores** use the same F·R·A scale as [prospects.md](./prospects.md#how-a-prospect-is-scored): **F**it (5 = already in our code), **R**each (5 = millions of the right users or buyers), **A**ccess (5 = self-serve form, 1 = no public route), summed to 3-15.

## The plan

Every active program sits in exactly one wave. Work the waves in order; inside a wave, work top to bottom (highest score first). A program moves waves only when its status changes, so updating status is how the plan stays current.

## Who promotes partners

The open programs on this page that will put three.ws in front of their audience: co-marketing, social posts, blog posts, case studies, newsletters, featured placement, events, podcasts, press, or a partner badge. Ranked by promotion value: the program score plus two points for each kind of promotion one ask earns. Ask for the promotion in the same message as the application; it is far easier to get on the way in than after. The cross-sector view is [promotion-programs.md](./promotion-programs.md).

| Program | Company | Promotion offered | How to get it | Status |

## Keeping it true

- **Never set `member` without proof**: an acceptance email, a portal that shows the membership, or a live listing. Record the proof as a `--log` entry with `--ref`.
- **Never upgrade a designation.** Program names and tiers are quoted exactly as the partner writes them; the framing rules in [partners.md](../partners.md#what-the-page-does-not-claim) apply here too.
- **Log the day it happens.** A submission that is not logged did not happen as far as the next person is concerned, and they will submit it again.
- **Re-sweep quarterly.** Programs get renamed, folded, and retired every few months. When a page 404s or redirects, set `closed` with the reason and the date so nobody re-researches it.
- **A new membership** also needs a card on `/partners` and `/partners/benefits` and a row in [partners.md](../partners.md) (see [partner-benefits.md](../partner-benefits.md#editing-rules)).
